summary: This code implements an HTML5 Canvas space exploration game called "NASA Space Apps: Deep Space Mission." Players pilot a spaceship, dodging and shooting meteors, aliens, and space debris while collecting fuel and upgrades. The game features interactive space quizzes and multi-level boss battles against "Labubu" characters across progressive difficulty levels.
details: Here, we have tried to teach children about the planets and explain the issue of space debris in an accessible way.
